notes.text:
This update for amazon-cloudwatch-agent fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-63209: github.com/klauspost/compress: signed integer overflow in s2.NewDict() allows an attacker to bypass
  repeat index validation and cause a process crash (bsc#1283594).

Changes for amazon-cloudwatch-agent:

Update to version 1.300073.0
 
 * [Agent] Add Google Cloud support for GCE and GKE by @jefchien
 in (#2255), (#2258) and (#2260)
 * [Agent] Add opt-in self-telemetry endpoint for agent metrics
 by @movence in (#2246)
 * [ContainerInsights] Add KEDA and Karpenter metrics scraping
 by @Paamicky in (#2250)
 * [ContainerInsights] Add watch_replicaset toggle to disable the
 ReplicaSet informer by @movence in (#2246)
 * [Metrics/JMX] Format JVM metric units for Tomcat by @Paamicky
 in (#2235)
 * [ContainerInsights] Fix EKS OTel Container Insights log delivery
 and stabilize cluster-scoped metric identity by @sky333999
 in (#2249)
 * [ContainerInsights] Only resolve cluster name when running
 in Kubernetes by @Paamicky in (#2259)
 * [Logs] Prevent high log throughput from stalling log collection
 while recording file read progress by @lorespiz in (#2253)
- Update github.com/klauspost/compress to v1.18.7
 (bsc#1283594, CVE-2026-63209)

notes.text: compress provides various compression algorithms. Prior to version 1.18.7, a signed integer overflow vulnerability in s2.NewDict() allows an attacker to bypass repeat index validation by supplying a dictionary with a uvarint-encoded repeat value exceeding MaxInt64. When Dict.Encode() is subsequently called, the overflowed negative repeat value causes an out-of-bounds memory access via unsafe.Pointer arithmetic, crashing the process with SIGSEGV. This issue has been patched in version 1.18.7.
